subject: OTLP Broker Pilot — dogfood schedule, marketplace cert, and partner readiness
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: OTLP Broker pilot — kickoff items and dogfood week

Team,

Following up from last week's sync: LightOps has agreed to be our first pilot customer for the OTLP broker (they want the Datadog + Grafana path validated). I sketched an MVP test plan and architecture diagram (attached). High level asks:

- Confirm marketplace certification steps for Datadog (who owns submission vs. partner acceptance)
- Lock a 1-week dogfood window (we're aiming for 09/13-09/17)
- Identify compliance evidence needed for marketplace listing (SOC2 artifact, data flow diagram, retention policy)
- Define success criteria for the pilot (throughput targets, latency SLO, error budget)

Attachments: otlp-broker-arch.png, MVP-test-plan.xlsx

Laura — can you own marketplace certification coordination with partners/datadog?
Ben — will you own the LightOps commercial MOU and onboarding terms?
Soojin — can you scope the cert items that affect the runtime (keys, logging, audit) and confirm we can meet them in the dogfood window?

I think if we push the internal prep this week we can get a marketplace pre-scan and a signed MOU before the pilot.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

I'll take point on the marketplace path. Quick notes from my side:

- Datadog marketplace requires a vendor submission + partner review cycle. Typical lead time: 3-4 weeks for technical review, faster if we provide a pre-scanned runbook and test harness.
- I'll ask Mark Spencer (Grafana) for any cert exemptions on visualization plugins — they usually fast-track integrations that ship with clear install scripts.
- For evidence: SOC2 scope is the biggest gating item. If we can provide the SOC2 type II report and a short data flow diagram (we have one in the drive I linked), the marketplace team can usually proceed to technical validation.

I'll start the intake form today and loop Datadog partners; adding check: marketplace-cert-checklist.pdf attached.

Laura Bennett
Head of Integrations | Redwood Inference

To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T12:15:00Z
Subject: Re: OTLP Broker pilot — kickoff items and dogfood week

Thanks — quick commercial notes:

- I'll circulate a one-page MOU to LightOps today that covers scope, pilot duration, confidentiality, and data handling. Expect a draft by EOD PST.
- LightOps asked about billing during pilot — proposed approach: no-charge pilot for first week, then a committed pilot seat if they push to extended testing. We can offer a short credit instead of an invoice.
- Compliance: if Soojin confirms runtime log retention isn't exposing PII, Legal is comfortable with the pilot MOU. If we need longer data retention controls, that'll land as a feature request.

+Ben

Hi Mateo / Ben — thanks for the outline, excited to move forward. A few items on our side:

2) Commercial MOU (Ben) — draft to LightOps by 2026-08-31 EOD.

I will also request a short pre-scan with Datadog partners (cc'd) to see if they prefer a sandbox submission first. If Datadog wants a sandbox run we'll prioritize a short smoke test before 09/13.

Please reply-all with any critical blockers. If no objections by 2026-09-02 I will mark this schedule as firm and notify LightOps.

Cheers,
Mateo
